exit 0
--- stdout
Retire an exact command (for example a renamed or removed test) from the
effective batch set for every deferral recorded so far. History is kept, and a
task merged later that defers the same command puts it back.
Usage:
liza deferred-validation retire [flags]
Flags:
--command string exact canonical command
-h, --help help for retire
--json output result as structured JSON
--ruling string decision that authorizes this change
Global Flags:
--check-update check for a Liza update before running
-C, --project-root string Liza project root for state commands
--update-channel string update check channel: stable or main (default "stable")
-v, --verbose verbose output
--- stderr
